title: Brandon Aiyuk says he 'is not cool' with 49ers' John Lynch and Kyle Shanahan, claims he fired agent

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aiyuk says he 'is not cool' with 49ers' John Lynch and Kyle Shanahan, claims he fired agent
sources.description: In a video posted to YouTube, Aiyuk criticized 49ers GM John Lynch and coach Kyle Shanahan, adding that he fired his agent in November.
